items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Billy Eckstine recorded one of mine.

ctx.x: Were some recorded by bands other than--people other than you were associated with?
A lot of my tunes were recorded by Jo Stafford, Billy Eckstine recorded one of mine. I've had several records of some of the tunes.
Did you decide you wanted to be a songwriter or just found yourself being a songwriter?
